comments.author: Artakwa
comments.body:
We are happy to announce **Language of Diplomacy (LoD)!**

It's the first projct with my friend together and we are happy how it's going. We startet our "open" alpha today with only 100 slots. It's mostly fun in multiplayer i think. But for testing I also played it alot solo.

In LoD, you rule a nation and decide what your government does next. You give the orders, and the AI simulates the consequences based on real-world datasets for every country.

You can change the world map through your actions. The game is focused on multiplayer. You can chat with your friends and come to agreements, which are written down and interpreted by the same AI.

The world evolves through the actions of all players. You can go to war, conduct espionage, or build a peaceful world.

Hope it's maybe intresting. :)

You can play it here: [https://lod-game.com](https://lod-game.com)
